verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs say social login is added through the admin console by "selecting the social network you want to add" with "no code or changes to your application." Any external OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 provider can be brokered the same way, purely through configuration, and users can link multiple providers to one account. Community reports corroborate this: Google SSO "took a few settings," and another team ran many external IdPs integrated for SSO for years. missing for 10: an enumerated list of the built-in social providers showing the breadth of out-of-the-box coverage.
